Thru3D frame interpolation
Copyright (C) 2026 FFSky Studio and contributors.

Thru3D implements motion-compensated frame interpolation in C++ and GLES 3
fragment shaders (native/xr-layer/frame_interp.cpp and interp_glsl.h).
It estimates motion in both directions using coarse-to-fine luma block
matching, then synthesizes pictures for each display refresh. It also
processes each eye independently for 2D-to-3D playback.

Algorithm reference: MVTools for AviSynth, by the MVTools contributors.
https://github.com/pinterf/mvtools
Its motion-vector prediction and coherence penalty informed the shader design.
The VapourSynth port of MVTools was used for offline sample generation and
comparisons. The APK runs Thru3D's C++ code and GLES shaders.

The Thru3D implementation is distributed under the GNU General Public License
version 3. The full project license accompanies this notice.
